items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: Oliver Giles, he played in the Onward band with Oscar Giles. Oscar Giles played the bass drum and Oliver Giles played the snare drum.

ctx.x: I'm gonna put this up here to prevent six kids from interrupting as the wind is blowing against the microphone. Makes the needle jump a little bit. It's nice to have that breeze here on the hot Davidson. That's better now. Okay, excuse me. You were talking about your uncles now?

Yeah. Oliver Giles, he played in the Onward band with Oscar Giles. Oscar Giles played the bass drum and Oliver Giles played the snare drum. And Major Giles, well he played mostly around Thibodeau too. But so far as him playing in any band in Yardins, I don't know anything concerning that. Yeah. Um, this drum set your father had, it was a regular

dance drum set with bass drum and snare and everything? That's right. Set up like they do now in the jazz band? Well, it was a little different. I've heard he made his own foot pedal. Oh yes, in the old days they had one. Yeah.

items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: And Oliver Giles, he was snare drummers. He only played snare drummers.

ctx.x: What about your uncles now? How many of them were outstanding?

Well Oscar Giles, he was a drummer. He only played bass drum too. And Oliver Giles, he was snare drummers. He only played snare drummers. He didn't play trap drummers. And Major Giles, he was a drummer when he played trap drummers.
